title: Aldous Huxley takes a high dose of LSD while dying

tellings.quote: >> he I think at the end of his life was uh was dying and he asked his wife to uh give him an extremely high dose of LSD.

plain: The writer Aldous Huxley is said to have asked his wife, as he lay dying in 1963, to give him a very high dose of LSD, a powerful psychedelic drug. Michels mentions it himself, somewhat tentatively, while talking with the neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore about how such drugs might open the mind to other realms.
